name: jjd
description: JJD App - plateforme de gestion JJD Consult (chantiers, equipes, planning, portail client)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run db:reset --workspace @jjd/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @jjd/shared && npm run test --workspace @jjd/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @jjd/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @jjd/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @jjd/web
scripts.import:all: npm run import -w @jjd/api && npm run import:vehicles -w @jjd/api && npm run import:trustup -w @jjd/api
